``` At La Constancia we care for a living arboretum with **more than 300 species** of trees and shrubs, in Mar del Plata. Unlike most nature projects, here **every tree is traceable** —it has its own profile, location and QR code—, and the data is open. That turns your company's contribution into **measurable, verifiable impact, with no greenwashing**. We work with companies in **several ways**: joining the Business Network is one of them, but you can also book a specific experience or sponsor a program. Choose the one that best fits your organization. ::: grid ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Corporate experiences and events *Team-building* days, **wellbeing and forest bathing**, retreats, birdwatching and events in a unique setting. Network membership is not required. [See corporate events →](events.html){.btn .btn-outline-success .btn-sm role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### 🌱 Impact partnerships (ESG) Sponsor the arboretum's conservation and receive an **annual impact report** —biodiversity and estimated carbon— traceable and branded with your company. Ideal for sustainability reports. [Enquire →](contact.html){.btn .btn-outline-success .btn-sm role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Sponsored education (CSR) Fund school visits and educational materials. A concrete social-responsibility story with local reach. [Enquire →](contact.html){.btn .btn-outline-success .btn-sm role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### The platform Do you have a green space or collection? Bring it to a **digital atlas** like this one. [Learn about the system →](platform.html){.btn .btn-outline-success .btn-sm role="button"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### Business Network Join a **network of purpose-driven companies**, with ongoing benefits, networking and shared impact. [Discover the Network →](#red){.btn .btn-success .btn-sm role="button"} ::: ::: ## Why La Constancia ::: grid ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} **Full transparency**
Open data, one profile and one QR code per tree. ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} **Scientific method**
Biodiversity indices and carbon estimation with recognized methodology. ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} **A platform that works**
This very website is living proof of what we do. ::: ::: ## Our impact ::: grid ::: {.g-col-3 .card .p-3 .text-center .shadow-sm .m-1}
+300
Species

::: ::: # The Arboretum Business Network {#red} The **Arboretum Business Network** invites organizations to be part of a project that integrates **nature, wellbeing, education and community**. Joining means building a legacy that lasts, with **traceable and verifiable** impact. ::: {.panel-tabset} ### Why join? - Be part of the first botanical garden in Mar del Plata, a place where nature, community and companies generate real impact. - Associate your organization with values of sustainability, innovation and the future. - Join a business network with purpose. ### Benefits - Presence on social media and institutional materials. - Business networking. - Gatherings on sustainability and triple impact. - Wellbeing activities in nature. - Corporate volunteering days. ### How to take part - Sponsorship of arboretum projects. - In-kind contributions or institutional collaboration. ::: ### Projects you can support ::: grid ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} 🪧 **Educational signage** ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} **Interpretive trails** ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} 🪑 **Benches and resting areas** ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} **Species identification** ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} 🚻 **Ecological, inclusive restrooms** ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} 🌱 **Reforestation and new collections** ::: ::: ### Founding companies of the Network
*Founding companies have supported the Network from the start. Would you like to add yours?* ## Coordination ::: grid ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm .text-center} ![](../fotos/magda.jpg){.admin-photo} ### Magdalena Zurita Institutional coordination, educational programs and conservation. [🔗 LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/magdalenazurita/){target="_blank"} ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm .text-center} ![](../fotos/juan.jpg){.admin-photo} ### Juan Ignacio Zurita Strategic development, business relations and institutional communication. [🔗 LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/juan-ignacio-z-4b345425/){target="_blank"} ::: ::: ## Where we're heading We are building high-value data capabilities for research and development partners: **climate-resilience data**, a **phenology network** with sensors, a **digital twin** of the arboretum, and **AI-ready datasets**. If your company is looking to the future of nature and data, let's talk. ## Express your interest ::: {.callout-tip} Tell us what your organization is looking for and we'll put together a tailored proposal. [I want to work with the arboretum](contact.html){.btn .btn-success .btn-lg role="button"} **[laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com](mailto:laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com)** [Download corporate dossier (PDF, in Spanish)](../recursos/dossier_empresas.pdf) ::: ## Contact and location **Email:** [laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com](mailto:laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com) **Location:** Arboretum at Estancia La Constancia, Camino 515, Mar del Plata, Argentina Open in Google Maps ## Discover the project ```{=html}
```
